competencies.title: Observation acquisition
competencies.claim: Detect and designate an observable contact without treating unknown evidence as absence.
competencies.limitation: Scenario-bound evidence; not calibrated proficiency or operational readiness.

competencies.title: Evidence-based classification
competencies.claim: Distinguish supported classification from information the sensors cannot resolve.
competencies.limitation: Scenario-bound evidence; not calibrated proficiency or operational readiness.

competencies.title: Restraint under uncertainty
competencies.claim: Hold or monitor when the available evidence does not justify an active response.
competencies.limitation: Scenario-bound evidence; not calibrated proficiency or operational readiness.

competencies.title: Response reasoning
competencies.claim: Choose a permitted illustrative response using available evidence and constraints.
competencies.limitation: Scenario-bound evidence; not calibrated proficiency or operational readiness.

competencies.title: Degraded evidence handling
competencies.claim: Interpret and respond to the evidence actually available during a sensor degradation.
competencies.limitation: Scenario-bound evidence; not calibrated proficiency or operational readiness.

competencies.title: Crew coordination
competencies.claim: Communicate and acknowledge evidence with role attribution.
competencies.limitation: Scenario-bound evidence; not calibrated proficiency or operational readiness.

items.title: Observation acquisition: practice A
items.objective: Detect and designate an observable contact without treating unknown evidence as absence.
instructions: Select an observed contact; retain uncertainty when evidence is insufficient.
Make your own designation, classification and response choices.
After completion, inspect the verified evidence and explain one choice.
items.reflection: Which observation supported your choice, and what remained uncertain?
